insight: Its 2024 GXO deal was widely reported as the first formal commercial humanoid deployment; a 2025 round valued it near $1.8B.
name: Agility Robotics
tagline: Maker of Digit, the humanoid robot already doing paid work in warehouses.
description: Agility Robotics builds Digit, a bipedal humanoid for warehouse and factory material handling, orchestrated by its Arc cloud platform. Digit works production shifts at GXO — 100,000+ totes moved at a single site — with commercial agreements at Schaeffler, Mercado Libre, and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada. Robots are assembled at the company's RoboFab factory in Salem, Oregon.

modelSupport.notes: Onboard autonomy stack, managed and orchestrated by the Arc cloud platform.

edge: While most humanoid rivals run pilots, Digit already does paid production work — over 100,000 totes moved in commercial deployment at GXO.
pros: Arc cloud platform for fleet ops
cons: Enterprise RaaS only — no direct sales
Scope limited to logistics tasks today
Not yet cleared to work beside humans
